product_one_liner.value: Safety Cloud sends real-time digital alerts about roadside hazards and approaching emergency vehicles to drivers, helping public-safety and roadway fleets protect responders, workers, and motorists.

employee_band.notes: Built In Chicago reports 70 total employees.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows product and marketing/editorial posts rather than two engineering-authored posts on how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public Knowledge Base FAQ links to multiple product and support articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists RevOps Manager / GTM Engineer, Product Manager, and Technical Delivery & Solutions Lead; none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The public product FAQ, Trust Center, privacy material, and blog reviewed do not name an AI model or provider used by Safety Cloud.
